mainEntity.name: Which payment methods does Immigrate to Brazil accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consultations and agreed services may be paid through PIX, PayPal, Payoneer, Wise, direct bank transfer, Bitcoin, or USDT. Some methods require current written details before payment is sent.

mainEntity.name: When does Immigrate to Brazil treat a consultation as confirmed?

acceptedAnswer.text: A consultation is only confirmed after payment has been verified, matched to the enquiry, and confirmed manually in writing. Payment alone is not treated as a confirmed booking.

mainEntity.name: What proof should I send after paying Immigrate to Brazil?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a clear screenshot, receipt, or transfer record showing the amount, date, sender, and any reference that helps identify the payment. Clear proof allows faster confirmation.

mainEntity.name: Can I arrange bank transfer, Bitcoin, or USDT with Immigrate to Brazil?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but those methods should be arranged first. Use only current written details shared directly for your payment, not outdated screenshots or forwarded wallet information.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my timing is urgent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact the team before paying if your timing is urgent. The 36-hour scheduling rule still applies, and it is better to confirm what is realistic before sending funds.
